channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: BMW Group India Returns as Presenting Partner of India Art Fair 2026, Marking a Decade-long Cultural Commitment
item.description: BMW Group India returns as Presenting Partner of India Art Fair 2026, marking 10 years of partnership, with Afrah Shafiq’s art commission and the BMW Concept Speedtop showcased.

item.title: Sunburn Holi Weekend 2026 to Light Up India with KSHMR’s Five-City Tour
item.description: Sunburn Holi Weekend 2026 will see global EDM star KSHMR headline a high-energy five-city India tour this March, blending cinematic electronic music with festive Holi celebrations.

item.title: HRAWI Conducts FSSAI FoSTaC Food Safety Training Programme in Indore
item.description: HRAWI conducted FSSAI’s FoSTaC food safety training in Indore, equipping 21 hospitality professionals with practical insights on hygiene, sanitation, and safe food handling practices.

item.title: LogiMAT India 2026 Kicks Off in Mumbai, Focuses on Skill Development and Global Collaboration
item.description: LogiMAT India 2026 opened in Mumbai with strong global participation and a renewed focus on bridging the logistics talent gap through industry-led skilling, innovation, and international collaboration.

item.title: NCPA Brings India’s Diverse Dance Forms to the Forefront with Mumbai Dance Season 2026
item.description: A month-long celebration at NCPA Mumbai, the Mumbai Dance Season 2026 brings together India’s folk, tribal, and classical dance traditions through performances by distinguished artistes and ensembles.

item.title: IHC Samanvay 2026 Commences with Focus on Ecology, Heritage, and the Future
item.description: IHC Samanvay 2026 opened at India Habitat Centre with reflections on ecology, culture, and India’s living traditions, bringing together leading voices from literature, environmental thought, and the performing arts.

item.title: Shikhar Dhawan Appointed Brand Ambassador of Inaugural Delhi Khel Mahakumbh
item.description: Shikhar Dhawan has been named Brand Ambassador of the inaugural Delhi Khel Mahakumbh, a Government of Delhi initiative focused on promoting grassroots sports and young talent.

item.title: Thomas Cook India and SOTC Travel Sign Strategic MOU with Mauritius Tourism Promotion Authority
item.description: Thomas Cook India and SOTC Travel have signed a strategic MOU with the Mauritius Tourism Promotion Authority to strengthen Mauritius’ presence in the Indian travel market.

item.title: Aamir Khan Delights Fans With Exhibition Match at World Pickleball League 2026
item.description: Bollywood megastar Aamir Khan thrilled fans at the World Pickleball League 2026 by playing a special exhibition match, adding star power and excitement to a high-voltage semi-final night in Mumbai.

item.title: TripStaq Showcases Powerful Hotel Booking Platform at OTM 2026
item.description: TripStaq showcased its B2B hotel booking platform at OTM 2026, engaging global travel trade partners with its scalable, tech-driven solution.
